method: Site polygons (OS Open Greenspace, EPSG:27700, OGL v3) INTERSECTED with ONS WD24 BGC ward boundaries requested in EPSG:27700, so only the part of each site that actually falls inside a ward is counted. Replaces step 10's centroid rule, which assigned each site wholly to the ward containing its centre point and therefore credited whole large parks to one ward (East Sheen held 165% of its own land area in play space) while giving neighbouring wards none of the same park. Areas are shoelace in native British National Grid metres; no reprojection is performed. A site spanning several wards is counted once in each ward's site count, with its area divided between them.
